[All pages](README.md).

### [`assistant-card.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-card.tsx)

- `AssistantCardView` _component_: A park, a ride, a park's rides or a few parks as a card in Parky's chat: the site's own status, crowd and wait chips and photos on live data. A single park or ride is one link; in a list every row links its own page.

### [`assistant-challenge.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-challenge.tsx)

- `AssistantChallenge` _component_: The challenge in Parky's window, drawn as part of it rather than as a bare Cloudflare box. Almost always it passes unseen: Parky's mark turns and a line says it is checking.

### [`assistant-feedback-form.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-feedback-form.tsx)

- `AssistantFeedbackForm` _component_: Feedback about the site, sent with the page it was written on and, when one is open, the chat, so the admin can read both together. The e-mail is only for those who want an answer.

### [`assistant-launcher.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-launcher.tsx)

- `AssistantLauncher` _component_: Parky, bottom right: only the round icon until it is pressed, then a small chat window above it.

### [`assistant-location-ask.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-location-ask.tsx)

- `AssistantLocationAsk` _component_: Parky's question for the visitor's position, answered in the chat: nothing is read until the visitor presses „Standort teilen".

### [`assistant-message-text.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-message-text.tsx)

- `AssistantMessageText` _component_: One answer of Parky as text. The answer is model output: raw HTML is dropped, only a handful of elements render, everything else is unwrapped to its text.

### [`assistant-panel.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-panel.tsx)

- `AssistantPanel` _component_: The window Parky opens in: the chat and, on its second tab, the feedback form. Mounted once the launcher was first pressed and kept, so a closed and reopened chat is where it was.

### [`assistant-teaser.tsx`](../../components/assistant/assistant-teaser.tsx)

- `AssistantTeaser` _component_: A short line beside the closed Parky button ("Hey, ich bin Parky – klick mich an!"), at most twice a session and never once Parky was opened or a line was closed. A press on the line opens Parky.

### [`parky-logo.tsx`](../../components/assistant/parky-logo.tsx)

- `ParkyLogo` _component_: Parky's face: a speech bubble in the brand's blue to green with big eyes that follow the mouse, rosy cheeks and a smile, and for a hat a Ferris wheel with coloured cabins on an A-frame.
- Types: `ParkyMood`

### [`use-assistant-actions.ts`](../../components/assistant/use-assistant-actions.ts)

- `useAssistantActions` _hook_: Carries out what Parky asked for, through the site's own paths: the router for a page, the planner's store and its open and optimise signals for the plan, so every write is counted and undoable like a press of the planner's own buttons.
